reason: I already take magnesium at night at home and I reorder my usual brand when it runs out. The 'to go' part is useless to me, I'm not carrying it anywhere.
objection: I already have a magnesium I take at home, so why switch for a sachet I don't need to travel with.
would_change_my_mind: If it were clearly cheaper per day than what I buy now, or my current one stopped being available.
